lines.t: The trees were praising before I woke.
Wind through the branches.
Light through the window.
I’ve spent all week answering everything.
This morning—
I turn toward You.
Phone face down, let the whole thing wait,
Sun on the floor like an open gate.
Boots by the door with the week still on them,
Hands open now; I don’t need to solve it.
There’s bread on the table, a chair pulled near,
Nothing I need to impress You with here.
I bring the unfinished, the work, the worry,
The thoughts still running when my feet stop hurrying.
I’ve been calling myself Your servant,
Trying to carry what I ought to surrender.
Now I sit with the window open,
Hear the leaves, and begin to remember.
You were Lord when the week went sideways.
You are Lord when the room goes still.
I can leave the tools where I laid them
And receive this day as a gift.
Creation has a thousand voices;
I’ve been too distracted to hear.
Let my breathing join the chorus.
Let my attention settle here.
WHO MADE THE MORNING?
TO YOU BE THE PRAISE!
WHO HOLDS MY BREATH?
TO YOU BE THE PRAISE!
WHAT CAN I BRING YOU?
These open hands.
WHERE DO I WANT TO BE?
Here with You.
Here with You.
Here with You.
Here with You, where the quiet is alive,
Sabbath light across my tired eyes.
YahuShua, nothing sweeter than to come
With my heart uncovered, held within Your love.
Let the mountains keep their thunder.
Let the sea lift up its song.
I will join them with thanksgiving—
Here with You is where I long.
Here with You is where I long.
Listen to the rain make a drum of the roof,
Little bird singing like it’s got something to prove.
Sky so wide that I lose my sentence,
Then a small breeze brings me back to the present.
I can laugh without reaching for a reason.
I can taste what I’m eating this evening.
Hear my children making up a melody—
Let them interrupt the solemn face I’m keeping.
Let this house have room for delight,
For an honest prayer, for a nap in the light.
For the passage we read, then read again,
For the friend who needs somewhere to spend
An unhurried hour without an appointment,
A place at the table, somebody listening.
Teach me to welcome as I am welcomed,
Let the rest I receive become kindness.
REST—LET THE SHOULDERS FALL!
PRAISE—LET THE WHOLE HOUSE CALL!
YAHUSHUA—OUR JOY, OUR SONG!
HERE IN YOUR LOVE IS WHERE WE BELONG!
REST—LET THE HURRY CEASE!
PRAISE—WITH AN OPEN HEART!
ALL CREATION, LIFT YOUR VOICE!
LET THE CHILDREN OF THE LORD REJOICE!
[Bridge — intimate duet, no percussion]
I thought I had to fill the silence.
We can let the silence stay.
I thought that resting meant I’d failed Him.
We can bring that fear and pray.
There are things we cannot settle
Before the evening comes.
We can lay them down a moment
And remember we are loved.
Secret place, beyond the showing,
Where I have no crowd to move.
Let us come with nothing hidden.
Let us spend this time with You.
[Spoken Scripture — single dry voice]
“He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most High
shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty.”
A river doesn’t need my permission.
The morning doesn’t wait for my plan.
I don’t keep the whole world living.
I can open up my hands.
Let the bass shake loose the hurry.
Let the choir rise bright and clear.
Then take every sound away—
You are worthy of my hearing.
Here with You, where the quiet is alive,
Sabbath light across my tired eyes.
YahuShua, nothing sweeter than to come
With my heart uncovered, held within Your love.
Let the mountains keep their thunder.
Let the sea lift up its song.
I will join them with thanksgiving—
Here with You is where I long.
ALL CREATION—GIVE HIM GLORY!
EVERY BREATH—RETURN HIS PRAISE!
OPEN HANDS AND HEARTS BEFORE HIM!
THANK YOU, LORD, FOR SABBATH DAYS!
The week is unfinished.
The sky is turning gold.
I don’t pick the phone up yet.
Thank You
For letting me be here.
